title: Machine learning-based pathomics signature could act as a novel prognostic marker for patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
summary: A pathomics signature separates renal-cancer survival risk across three patient cohorts, including two independent validation cohorts. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
